claim: Shadow resolution collapses when view and light line up: at one land_small camera position (pitch -25, light (0, -0.54, 0.84)), shadow texels per metre on the view ray at 20/60/140 m are 13.9/10.0/6.4 side-on to the sun (yaw 90), 5.1/5.1/5.0 with the sun behind the camera (yaw 0) and 2.5/2.3/2.0 at yaw 45; farz stays 250.5; yaw 45 and 315 (same sun angle) differ 3.6x, so the fit also depends on the scene (caster crop). This is the low-quality shadows Liam sees with the sun behind the camera
